metadata.description: Claude plugins for Red Wagon's marketing tools: SEO audits, email audits, competitor email intelligence, keyword research, popups, PPC grading, social scheduling, marketing data and press distribution.

plugins.name: searchauditpro
plugins.description: Turn a SearchAuditPro SEO audit into a prioritized fix plan: triage 200+ technical and on-page checks, backlink gaps, rank tracking and AI-answer visibility data into tickets with owners and acceptance criteria. Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to SearchAuditPro (searchauditpro.com), Red Wagon's own product and services.

plugins.name: e-mail-grader
plugins.description: Audit an email marketing program the way E-Mail Grader does: score workflows, list quality, engagement, creative, integrations/compliance and revenue impact, then produce a prioritized improvement plan. Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to E-Mail Grader (e-mailgrader.com), Red Wagon's own product and services.

plugins.name: competitorinbox
plugins.description: Analyze competitor email programs captured with CompetitorInbox: send frequency, timing, subject-line patterns, automated flow structure, ESP and authentication, and turn the findings into a swipe file and a competitive playbook. Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to CompetitorInbox (competitorinbox.com), Red Wagon's own product and services.

plugins.name: unboundkeyword
plugins.description: Keyword research workflow across Google, YouTube, Amazon and TikTok using UnboundKeyword exports: question discovery, A–Z and autocomplete expansion, competitor gap, clustering by intent, and a content map. Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to UnboundKeyword (unboundkeyword.com), Red Wagon's own product and services.

plugins.name: optinyeti
plugins.description: Plan and write high-converting popups, floating bars, slide-ins, welcome mats and spin-to-win campaigns for OptinYeti: triggers, targeting rules, offer and copy, A/B plan, and install via snippet, WordPress, Shopify or GTM. Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to OptinYeti (optinyeti.com), Red Wagon's own product and services.

plugins.name: ppcgrader
plugins.description: Grade Google, Meta and LinkedIn ad accounts using founder Joe Whyte's 25+ years of paid-media methodology, encoded into PPC Grader's A–F scoring: 40+ signals, wasted-spend estimate, veteran pattern-recognition heuristics, ranked fix list, and PPC Grader's 22 PPC skills (quality score, PMax, RSA, negatives, ASC, creative). Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to PPC Grader (ppcgrader.com), Red Wagon's own product and services.

plugins.name: threadly
plugins.description: Connect Claude to Threadly's social media MCP server: schedule and publish posts, pull cross-platform analytics, generate captions and hashtags, plan content calendars, and monitor mentions — plus a skill for running a weekly social workflow. Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to Threadly (threadlyhq.com), Red Wagon's own product and services.

plugins.name: markitech
plugins.description: Connect Claude to Markitech's marketing MCP server: 60+ read-only tools across Google Ads, GA4, Tag Manager, Search Console, Merchant Center, Business Profile, DV360, BigQuery, Sheets, Docs, Slides, Facebook Pages, Instagram and WhatsApp — plus a skill for cross-platform marketing reporting. Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to Markitech (markitech.app), Red Wagon's own product and services.

plugins.name: ridethewire
plugins.description: Write wire-ready press releases and plan distribution with RideTheWire: AP-style structure, headline and quote rules, word and link limits per package, newsroom vs. paid wire, and a post-distribution link report checklist. Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to RideTheWire (ridethewirepr.com), Red Wagon's own product and services.
